pins.name: RO
pins.notes: Receiver out, 5 V when powered from 5 V: use a divider before the ESP32 RX pin

pins.name: RE
pins.notes: Receiver enable, active LOW. Usually tied to DE and driven by one GPIO

pins.name: DI
pins.notes: Driver in. Connect to an ESP32 TX pin (3.3 V is a valid HIGH)

pins.name: B
pins.notes: RS-485 line B. To the bus, never to the ESP32

pins.name: A
pins.notes: RS-485 line A. To the bus, never to the ESP32

sources.title: Maxim MAX481/MAX483/MAX485 datasheet
sources.section: Supply 4.75 to 5.25 V; RO, RE, DE, DI, A, B pin functions; input HIGH threshold 2.0 V
